beats.name: The Scroll-Stop Hook
beats.inflection: [Intense Whisper / Shocked Eye Contact / Sudden Peak]
beats.text: I just finished an entire three-hundred page book in one afternoon.
beats.visual_action: Creator slaps a thick 300-page book onto table, staring into camera in disbelief.

beats.name: The Setup & Entities
beats.tone: rapid-fire matter-of-fact delivery and fast tempo
beats.text: Most people read at two hundred words per minute, meaning books sit unread on their nightstand.
beats.visual_action: Creator pans across a nightstand with 5 half-finished books.

beats.name: The Dramatic Twist
beats.tone: incredulous and shocked with building excitement
beats.role: The secret method and dual-sensory retention
beats.text: I loaded the whole book into VoiceReader, bumped the speed up to two-point-five, and because the synchronized text highlights every spoken word, my retention was actually higher than reading normally.
beats.visual_action: Close up on phone screen: speed slider hitting 2.5x, words glowing yellow as voice flies smoothly.

beats.name: The Moral Dilemma & Question
beats.tone: amused deadpan and engaging rising intonation
beats.role: Viral Engagement Engine: prompt debate in comments
beats.text: Would you try this speed-reading method, or is it way too fast?
beats.visual_action: Creator points down toward comment section with slight smirk.
